name: David Crowley
summary:
David Carl Crowley (; born May 14, 1986) is an American politician who is the governor-elect of Wisconsin. A member of the Democratic Party, he is the first African American to be elected governor of Wisconsin. 
Crowley has served since 2020 as the seventh executive of Milwaukee County, and served two terms in the Wisconsin State Assembly, representing Milwaukee's west side from 2017 to 2020.
